@code.description: Code in the parent folder, excluding autogen-doc; provenance in sources.json

folders.scope: Documentation versioned together with the code
Orientation to the domain and boundaries
Module, file, dependency and build inventory
Component responsibilities, wiring, specific AD patterns
End-to-end flows and rules with stable IDs

files.scope: Local application of the three workflows
files.editWhen: Local adaptation or upgrade of the method
files.procedure: Change with a reviewed diff and realign instructions and commands

files.scope: Questions, answers and residuals with stable IDs
files.editWhen: A doubt emerges or a source changes the answer
files.procedure: Preserve IDs, record evidence and residual, propagate links and references

files.scope: Readable catalog derived from the registry
files.procedure: Run verify-docs.cjs --docs autogen-doc --write-catalog from the code root
Assign owner/scope/upstream; regenerate the catalog and run the gate

files.scope: Local discipline for masters and copies
files.procedure: Review masters/copies and update the affected assignments

files.scope: Project identity, skill version and verified commands
files.editWhen: Skill version, target revision or verified command changes
files.procedure: Record observed values without claiming reviews that were not performed

files.scope: History of findings and sources read
files.procedure: Add date, source and consequence; do not alter historical entries

files.scope: Current unit status and references to verdicts
files.editWhen: Review, new content or source drift of a unit
files.procedure: Update unit/revision/limits; validated only with an independent report; add the reports as upstream in the registry

files.editWhen: Goal, coverage or layer applicability changes
files.procedure: Update inclusions/exclusions with a reason, without duplicating the review status
Qualify type, revision, environment and hash; reconcile consumers

files.scope: Orientation to the project context and boundaries
files.editWhen: Initial survey or the context changes
files.procedure: Read sources, document boundaries and propagate to navigation
Reconcile with the adopted method and review the instructions
Add an entry with the exact diff, checks and limits; do not rewrite history

files.editWhen: The reading path or the structure changes
files.procedure: Update links and map without duplicating statuses or domain rules

files.scope: Inventory of files, modules, dependencies, entrypoint, build
files.procedure: Check package.json, Dockerfile, folder layout; update the modules table

files.scope: Component responsibilities, wiring, AD patterns (ranged retrieval, batch resolution, UAC, DN parsing, primary group)
files.editWhen: Module responsibility or AD implementation pattern changes
files.procedure: Read src/*.js, trace the real wiring, do not infer from the file name

files.scope: End-to-end search/detail/export flows with stable IDs, rules
files.procedure: Trace entry->services->persistence/effects->outcome; update stable IDs, do not recycle

files.scope: Setup, env config, troubleshooting, Docker deploy, monitoring
files.editWhen: Setup/deploy procedure changes or new known problem
files.procedure: Check commands that were actually run, do not invent a procedure

files.editWhen: The structural contract or the tool version changes
files.procedure: Apply a reviewed upgrade, test valid and negative cases, regenerate the catalog
